\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization.formats.functions}
\begin{document}
\tikz \datavisualization [scientific axes,visualize as smooth line,
  x axis={ticks={major={no tick text at=3,
    also at=(pi) as [{tick text padding=1ex}] $\pi$}}},data/format=function]
data {var x : interval [0:2*pi] samples 20; func y = sin(\value x r);};
\end{document}
